summary: Verified extras are modest and conditional; they do not by themselves close the price gap. Largest levers: scrap-and-replace (central MOENV reward NT$2,300-2,800 per Business Today, or up to 3,300 per TVBS; city top-ups such as Tainan NT$6,500-8,000, New Taipei up to 10,000, Taoyuan up to 15,000), then group add-ons (low-income NT$10,000 in New Taipei and Taoyuan; Tainan low-income NT$14,000-16,500; Taoyuan delivery riders 3,000; Tainan delivery/young/child add-on 3,000, one only). Do the MOENV carbon-credit platform step before Tainan's application. Manufacturer deals seen are expired (Gogoro year-end ended 11/22; spring 2026 ended 1/25), and mostly accessory credits. Pitfalls: Tainan needs both 戶籍 and 車籍 in the city and bars transfer or moving registration for 3 years; New Taipei needs one year of residency; invoice must be dated 2026; filings close 2027-01-10; city quotas fill in order. No 2027 programme was found, and Taoyuan is still drafting. Financing, GoShare prices, group/student/credit-card offers and used or subscription options could not be checked this pass.
